sources_considered.why: Reports analyst estimates (UBS, Barclays) of OpenAI and Anthropic shares at individual hyperscalers, plus counterpoints. Much of the article relays the speaker's own arguments, which are not used as support.
Restates the speaker's own claims, so it cannot be evidence that he was right.
Shows NVIDIA guaranteeing OpenAI lease obligations, which bears on how OpenAI's compute is financed.
About the labs' own revenue, not providers' compute revenue shares.

evidence_items.locator: section The Concentration Numbers Across the Three Hyperscalers, paragraph 2

receipt.public_excerpt: At AWS, Barclays puts exposure to those same two customers at 13% this year, rising to 18% next year.

evidence_items.explanation: A Barclays estimate puts OpenAI and Anthropic at only 13% of AWS exposure in 2026. That sits uneasily with a sector-wide 'vast majority', but it covers a single provider and its metric is not clearly defined.

receipt.public_excerpt: Microsoft’s commercial RPO of $678 billion, up 84% year-over-year, and over 30 million paid Microsoft 365 Copilot seats.

evidence_items.explanation: A counterpoint pointing to enterprise AI demand beyond the two labs. It does not measure their share of compute revenue.

receipt.public_excerpt: NVIDIA entered into the SB Energy guarantees in August 2026, capped at a total of $105 billion, on behalf of a customer, an affiliate of OpenAI Group PBC.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows that third-party credit support stands behind OpenAI's data center leases. This is context on how OpenAI's compute is financed, dated after the post.

unresolved_gaps: No sector-wide measure of OpenAI and Anthropic's share of AI data center compute revenue across hyperscalers and neoclouds was found. Available figures are single-provider analyst estimates with unclear definitions, and they vary widely (13% at AWS per Barclays, 27% at Google Cloud per UBS).
No source quantified how far the two companies' compute payments depend on new fundraising rather than revenue in the target period.
